result:
Round 102 **passes**. I found no bugs, and every browser check for this round ran in real Chromium (`browserVerified` and `realVerified` are both `true`). I did not edit any app source, and the store's working tree is still exactly A's 3 modified files plus 1 new file on HEAD `56231c0`.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| **CARD-1280** (main check) | After a real WAV export, Tab to the "whole project" option scrolls the panel 0 → **59** (max 137). The option's card now ends **8 px above** the footer; before the fix it was 8 px under it. The radio is 24.5 px above the footer, a hit-test 2 px above the card's bottom lands on the card, and the card's top is still inside the panel. |
| **CARD-IDLE-REG** | 1280 idle and 1440 idle and done: nothing scrolls. The cards are 41, 86 and 86 px above the footer. |
| **AX-ONCE** | During a WAV render the progress text is no longer a separate text node. There is exactly one progress bar, named "ექსპორტის პროგრესი", and the dialog's text holds the progress string **once** (B's baseline had it twice). The MP3 sample, taken while the MP3 was being created, shows the same. The visible label is still on screen (494×16). |
| **VALUETEXT-REG** | 368 samples across render, WAV, load and MP3: the bar's text always matched the visible label. |
| **FOCUS-REG** | Tab order unchanged at both viewports, and focus never leaves the dialog. |
| **STRIP-REG** | No gap under the footer: 0 px at 1280 and 1440. |
| **EXPORT-REG** | WAV: real 2-channel, 48 kHz, 24-bit PCM, 101.352 s, no NaN samples. MP3: decodes in Web Audio at 101.352 s. |
| **PX-NET**, **REG-HYD** | No requests to the token, R2, recording or download endpoints, no `Authorization` headers, and no console errors, page errors or hydration warnings. |
| **G102-3** | Run alone, last of the browser checks, at both viewports. Anonymous `/studio-lab` opens the workspace with the demo badge. `/studio/middle-east` asks for sign-in, and `/api/studio-token` returns 401, so premium access is not bypassed. The fake-Bearer sub-check is blocked because the backend isn't available in the cloud. |
| **AN-REVIEW** | I re-ran the old-code check and mutations a, b, d and e in my own scratch copy and got the same failing tests as A. A's extra FC4 is explained. Assertions are exact, with no type assertions and no `@ts-`. The test change is one pure addition after line 491. |
| **T102-TARGETED** | My file search found the same 13 files as A, and 143/143 tests pass. |
| **SOURCE-UNCHANGED** | All 533 frozen files and the protected files are unchanged, and every diff hunk is inside the allowed line ranges. |

The full test suite, typecheck, build, Biome, `npm run verify` and the smoke e2e belong to the root gate, so I list them as gate rows and don't claim them.

Notes for B:
- **Garbled progress text in the accessibility dump:** Chrome's accessibility dump shows the Georgian progress text garbled. It is a dump artifact, not an app bug: re-decoding it gives exactly the correct Georgian, and the page's own attribute is correct.
- **Screen-reader risk (not checked):** A's code reviewer flagged that some screen readers, historically VoiceOver with Safari, ignore this text on a native progress bar. If so, those users would lose the phase text, most of all while the MP3 encoder loads. I can't check this with Chromium only; it stays a Tech Lead item.
- **Encoder-load sample:** I didn't get a clean accessibility sample during the MP3 encoder load (the snapshot lagged a step behind), so AX-ONCE for MP3 rests on the MP3-creation sample.
- **Footer during a render:** I didn't re-measure whether the footer stays visible during a render. Round 101's evidence still applies, and this round's change doesn't touch the footer layout.
- **Doc 090** has every required section and the five required items.
- **Proposal from A's code reviewer:** if this area changes again, merge the dialog's four focus effects into one local hook. It is a proposal only, for the backlog.
- **The next B planning on or after 2026-10-24 should be the regression round.**

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- `c-round-102.md`
- `c-round-102.json`
- `c-round-102/` (measurements and test logs in `out/`, screenshots in `shots/`, scripts in `tools/`)
